tasks.explanation: Present Perfect: have/has + V3. To he adds -s on the verb (have finished).
With yesterday we use Past Simple, not Present Perfect.

tasks.text: Make a question: she / ever / visit / London?
tasks.explanation: Has + subject + ever + V3 for questions.

tasks.text: Sample: I have never been to Paris. → Make a similar sentence about Tokyo.
tasks.sample: Sample: I have never been to Paris.
tasks.answer: I have never been to Tokyo.

tasks.text: Match the sentence with its meaning.
tasks.explanation: Present Perfect links past action to present result.

tasks.text: Select ALL sentences in Present Perfect.
options: We went to Spain last year.

tasks.text: Write 3–4 sentences about what you have done this week (school, hobbies).
criteria: Uses have/has + V3 at least twice
Sentences are about this week, not only past years
tasks.explanation: Check tense consistency and time markers (this week).

tasks.text: Explain when we use Present Perfect instead of Past Simple.
criteria: Mentions connection with present or unfinished time
Gives at least one example sentence
tasks.explanation: Look for contrast with finished past time (yesterday, in 2010).

tasks.text: Correct the mistake: He have done his homework.
tasks.explanation: With he/she/it use has, not have.

tasks.text: Translate: Я только что прочитал эту статью.
tasks.answer: I have just read this article.
tasks.explanation: Just + Present Perfect for very recent actions.
